description: This file contains utility functions for validating UUIDs, URLs, file paths, filenames, and ensuring MIME type and file extension consistency to prevent security vulnerabilities.

methods.name: isValidUUID
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid UUID v4 using regex pattern.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid URL by attempting to construct a URL object.

methods.name: isPathTraversal
methods.description: Detects common path traversal patterns in a string.

methods.name: isUnsafeFilePath
methods.description: Performs comprehensive checks for unsafe or malicious file paths, including directory traversal and absolute paths.

methods.name: validateMimeTypeAndExtensionMatch
methods.description: Ensures that the file extension matches the declared MIME type, addressing security concerns like MIME spoofing.
